verdict.rationale: Snyk's CLI is documented to run in CI/CD pipelines, with `snyk test`, `snyk code test` and `snyk secrets test` scan commands. A dedicated CI/CD service-account role and PR inline comments via the SCM integration are also documented. However, the pack never shows build failure via exit codes, severity thresholds, or diffing to flag only new findings per pull request. Missing for 10: documented non-zero exit codes and build-failure behavior, new-findings-only (baseline/diff) gating, per-PR CI pipeline examples, independent hands-on corroboration.
